card.name: Nouns after determiners in website notices
card.fires_on: A noun or adjective right after a determiner or verb in website boilerplate such as licences, disclaimers and site descriptions. Examples are "Each list", "any terms" and "provide balanced".

modes.label: Licence and terms wording
modes.description: Noun after a determiner in copyright or licence text.
modes.example: together with any<< terms>>, conditions and exclusions as set out

modes.label: Disclaimer wording
modes.description: Word after an article or preposition in a disclaimer about information use.
modes.example: Note: All information is for<< educational>> purposes only.

modes.label: Site description
modes.description: Word right after a verb or determiner in a site's self-description or help text.
modes.example: Each<< list>> contains commercially available species suitable for gardens and

card.plain: It fires on the next word in routine website notices, like licence terms and disclaimers.
